New message in #sales:

mike: does anyone know the current MRR for Acme Corp?

Want me to handle this in #sales? I can:
- Post “On it—will update shortly,” then fetch MRR
- Clarify what “current” means (today’s run-rate vs last full month) and whether to include only active subs

Which source should I use as the truth for MRR (Stripe/Salesforce/HubSpot/DB)? If no preference, I’ll use Stripe and reply with both: today’s run-rate and last full month.
